note: Rewritten from the original description of this new species in Emerson's account of the termites of Kartabo, original in English. The measurement names in the table are badly damaged in the PDF extraction (e.g. "Wenothe with WINGS" for Length with wings, "T1- .73" for Width of pronotum .71—.73); they have been restored from the row order and the value ranges, the word forms themselves being illegible; the row giving a queen length of 20.00 mm carries no measurement name in the original table.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate head is very dark blackish brown and oval, the fontanelle smaller than the ocelli, the antennae with 14 segments and segment 3 the shortest; it differs from M. bouvieri in the longer wings, from M. exiguus by being much larger, and from M. strunckii by the larger values of all measurements and the distinctly wider pronotum. The soldier has 13 antennal segments with segment 3 shorter than segment 4, and dark reddish brown sickle-shaped mandibles with serrate inner margins; according to the figure in Holmgren (1909, p. 88) the sides of the head of M. strunckii are straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head very dark blackish brown, with rather long hairs, oval; muscle attachment points indistinct. The fontanelle is smaller than the ocelli and sometimes rather inconspicuous. The antennae have 14 segments, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. The eyes are rather small and quite projecting, about 1/3 of an eye diameter from the lower margin. The ocelli are small, their distance from the eye greater than their diameter. The postclypeus is slightly paler than the head, with a pale median longitudinal line, its length about half its width. The pronotum is the same colour as the postclypeus and slightly paler than the head; its sides rather straight, its posterior margin slightly concave, its posterior corners rounded. The posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are broadly concave. The upper part of the tibiae is dark. The wings are smoky. The abdominal tergites are blackish brown. Measurements (the original labels are damaged by OCR; in the order of the table): length with wings 8.03—9.00 mm, length without wings 5.50—6.50 mm, head length 1.10—1.20 mm, head width 0.90—0.97 mm, antennal length 1.38—1.50 mm, eye diameter 0.27 mm, pronotum length 0.45—0.47 mm, pronotum width 0.71—0.73 mm, hind tibia length 0.96—1.00 mm, forewing length 6.50—7.43 mm, forewing width 1.89—2.10 mm, queen length 20.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, sometimes tinged with brown, darker anteriorly, with a brown spot behind the antennal bases; the head bears a few scattered setae and hairs; it is slightly oval, widest behind the antennae, the sides rather straight and slightly converging posteriorly. The antennae have 13 segments, segment 3 shorter than segment 4 and segment 4 shorter than segment 2. The labrum is rather long, pointed at the tip. The mandibles are dark reddish brown, sickle-shaped, with serrate inner margins. The anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly concave. The legs are pale. The abdomen is pale, the tergites with short hairs and a row of short erect setae on the posterior margin. Measurements: body length 4.00—5.00 mm, head with mandibles 2.67—2.73 mm, head width 0.93—0.97 mm, antennal length 1.45—1.50 mm, pronotum width 0.58—0.60 mm, hind tibia length 0.80—0.83 mm, length of the left mandible 1.27 mm.
